flavorText.crystal: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
flavorText.platinum: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

flavorText.crystal: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

flavorText.emerald: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.

flavorText.crystal: When heat from its body causes the air around it to shimmer, this is a sign that it is ready to battle.

flavorText.legends-arceus: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

flavorText.crystal: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Despite the smallness of its body, TOTODILE’s jaws are very powerful. While the POKéMON may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
flavorText.emerald: Despite its small body, TOTODILE’s jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

flavorText.crystal: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.

flavorText.gold-silver: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
flavorText.crystal: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
flavorText.emerald: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
flavorText.platinum: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
flavorText.gold-silver: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
flavorText.crystal: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this POKéMON becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
flavorText.emerald: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

flavorText.gold-silver: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
flavorText.crystal: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more maze like they become.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this POKéMON is very nimble and fleet.
flavorText.emerald: A FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

flavorText.crystal: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this POKéMON begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
flavorText.emerald: It has an internal organ that senses the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
flavorText.platinum: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

flavorText.sword-shield: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavorText.crystal: Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in darkness. This POKéMON owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
flavorText.emerald: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. NOCTOWL owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
flavorText.platinum: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavorText.black-white: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
