flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it “the emperor of dark nights.”
flavorText.sword-shield: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

flavorText.gold-silver: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavorText.crystal: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This POKéMON conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavorText.emerald: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavorText.platinum: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavorText.black-white: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavorText.x-y: When the weather turns cold, lots of Ledyba gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ledyba secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This Pokémon conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavorText.sun-moon: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon is very sensitive to cold. In the warmth of Alola, it appears quite lively.

flavorText.gold-silver: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavorText.crystal: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live LEDIAN in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this - the POKéMON uses the light of the stars as its energy.
flavorText.emerald: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavorText.platinum: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavorText.black-white: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavorText.x-y: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live Ledian in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this—the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.
flavorText.sun-moon: While it’s believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s said that the patterns on its back are related to the stars in the night sky, but the details of that relationship remain unclear.

flavorText.gold-silver: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavorText.crystal: If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The web spun by SPINARAK can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this POKéMON can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
flavorText.emerald: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavorText.platinum: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavorText.black-white: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavorText.x-y: It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The web spun by Spinarak can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
flavorText.sun-moon: It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly, gets caught in its web. In fact, it’s quite a patient Pokémon.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: With threads from its mouth, it fashions sturdy webs that won’t break even if you set a rock on them.

flavorText.gold-silver: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
flavorText.crystal: Rather than mak ing a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ARIADOS’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This POKéMON constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavorText.emerald: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavorText.platinum: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
flavorText.black-white: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavorText.x-y: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ariados’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavorText.sun-moon: There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

flavorText.x-y: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
flavorText.gold-silver: It flies so si lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavorText.crystal: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that CROBAT has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
flavorText.emerald: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
flavorText.platinum: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavorText.black-white: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that Crobat has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
flavorText.sun-moon: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won’t notice any pain or realize you’ve been bitten.
flavorText.sword-shield: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

flavorText.gold-silver: It shoots positive and negative elec tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavorText.crystal: Its antennae, whi ch evolved from a fin, have both po sitive and neg ative charges flo wing through them.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CHINCHOU lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This POKéMON flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
flavorText.emerald: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight’s reach.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavorText.platinum: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavorText.black-white: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavorText.x-y: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Chinchou lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This Pokémon flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its two antennae were originally fins. It discharges electricity to stun its prey before attacking.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

flavorText.gold-silver: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavorText.crystal: This POKéMON uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This POKéMON produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
flavorText.emerald: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavorText.platinum: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavorText.black-white: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavorText.x-y: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Lanturn is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This Pokémon produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
flavorText.sun-moon: Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn’s bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.
flavorText.sword-shield: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

flavorText.gold-silver: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavorText.crystal: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PICHU charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
flavorText.platinum: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavorText.black-white: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
flavorText.x-y: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pichu charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: It is not yet skilled at controlling electricity. If you take your eyes off it, it may shock itself.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It still can’t use electricity well. When it’s surprised or excited, it discharges electricity unintentionally.
flavorText.sword-shield: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

flavorText.gold-silver: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavorText.crystal: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this POKéMON is certain to be within the immediate area.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these POKéMON quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavorText.emerald: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
flavorText.platinum: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavorText.black-white: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.
flavorText.x-y: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these Pokémon quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavorText.sun-moon: On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!
flavorText.sword-shield: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.
flavorText.legends-arceus: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

flavorText.gold-silver: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavorText.crystal: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: IGGLYBUFF’s vocal chords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This POKéMON gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
flavorText.emerald: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavorText.platinum: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavorText.black-white: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.
flavorText.x-y: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Igglybuff’s vocal cords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This Pokémon gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
flavorText.sun-moon: It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it’s asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!
flavorText.sword-shield: Igglybuff loves to sing. Its marshmallow-like body gives off a faint sweet smell.

flavorText.gold-silver: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavorText.crystal: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. This POKéMON stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
flavorText.emerald: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
flavorText.platinum: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavorText.black-white: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
flavorText.x-y: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
flavorText.sword-shield: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
flavorText.gold-silver: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car ing people and shower them with happiness.
flavorText.crystal: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When the POKéMON spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
flavorText.emerald: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”
flavorText.platinum: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind hearted people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
flavorText.black-white: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
flavorText.x-y: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
flavorText.sword-shield: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
flavorText.legends-arceus: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

flavorText.gold-silver: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star ing at something.
flavorText.crystal: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NATU cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this POKéMON’s eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
flavorText.emerald: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU’s eyes look as if they are always observing something.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavorText.platinum: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
flavorText.black-white: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavorText.x-y: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Natu cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this Pokémon’s eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it still can’t fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

flavorText.gold-silver: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavorText.crystal: Once it begins to meditate at sun rise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: XATU stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this POKéMON does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
flavorText.emerald: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavorText.platinum: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavorText.black-white: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavorText.x-y: Once it begins to meditate at sunrise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Xatu stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this Pokémon does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
flavorText.sword-shield: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

flavorText.gold-silver: If static elec tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavorText.crystal: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAREEP’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail grows.
flavorText.emerald: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
flavorText.platinum: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavorText.black-white: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When cold weather increases static electricity, its wool doubles in size and the tip of its tail glows slightly.
flavorText.x-y: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Mareep’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Clothing made from Mareep’s fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.

flavorText.gold-silver: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
flavorText.crystal: Because of its rubbery, electric ity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electric ity in its fur.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FLAAFFY’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavorText.emerald: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
flavorText.platinum: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.
flavorText.black-white: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Not even downy wool will grow on its rubbery, nonconductive patches of skin that prevent electrical shock.
flavorText.x-y: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Flaaffy’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.

flavorText.gold-silver: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
flavorText.crystal: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this POKéMON to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavorText.emerald: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
flavorText.platinum: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
flavorText.black-white: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The tip of its tail shines so brightly it can be used to send sea-navigation beacons to distant foreign shores.
flavorText.x-y: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.

flavorText.gold-silver: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavorText.crystal: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This POKéMON’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
flavorText.emerald: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavorText.platinum: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavorText.black-white: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavorText.x-y: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Bellossom gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This Pokémon’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
flavorText.sword-shield: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

flavorText.gold-silver: The tip of its tail, which con tains oil that is lighter than wa ter, lets it swim without drowning.
flavorText.crystal: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MARILL’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this POKéMON is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
flavorText.emerald: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water’s resistance.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
flavorText.platinum: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
flavorText.black-white: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.
flavorText.x-y: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Marill’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this Pokémon is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon uses its round tail as a float. The ball of Marill’s tail is filled with nutrients that have been turned into an oil.

flavorText.gold-silver: By keeping still and listening in tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
flavorText.crystal: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AZUMARILL’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this POKéMON can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
flavorText.emerald: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
flavorText.platinum: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.
flavorText.black-white: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.
flavorText.x-y: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Azumarill’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
flavorText.sword-shield: It spends most of its time in the water. On sunny days, Azumarill floats on the surface of the water and sunbathes.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
flavorText.gold-silver: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
flavorText.crystal: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because the forelegs remain green throughout the year, the POKéMON is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
flavorText.emerald: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
flavorText.platinum: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
flavorText.black-white: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
flavorText.x-y: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sudowoodo camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because its hands remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
flavorText.sun-moon: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.
flavorText.sword-shield: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

flavorText.gold-silver: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather ing from far and wide.
flavorText.crystal: When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this POKéMON earns from its peers.
flavorText.emerald: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
flavorText.platinum: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
flavorText.black-white: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
flavorText.x-y: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The curled hair on Politoed’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.
flavorText.sun-moon: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although its cries sound like screams, a composer created a beautiful ballad that was influenced by the sounds.
flavorText.sword-shield: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

flavorText.gold-silver: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
flavorText.crystal: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves with other HOPPIP to prepare against being blown away.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
flavorText.platinum: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.
flavorText.black-white: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
flavorText.x-y: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

flavorText.gold-silver: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc tuates up and down.
flavorText.crystal: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SKIPLOOM’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this POKéMON is sometimes used as a thermometer.
flavorText.emerald: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower’s blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
flavorText.platinum: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
flavorText.black-white: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
flavorText.x-y: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavorText.gold-silver: Once it catches the wind, it deft ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
flavorText.crystal: Even in the fierc est wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The POKéMON descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
flavorText.emerald: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavorText.platinum: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.
flavorText.black-white: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavorText.x-y: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavorText.crystal: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AIPOM’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the POKéMON uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
flavorText.emerald: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM’s real hands have become rather clumsy.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
flavorText.platinum: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavorText.black-white: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
flavorText.x-y: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Aipom’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

flavorText.gold-silver: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavorText.crystal: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
flavorText.emerald: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavorText.platinum: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavorText.black-white: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.
flavorText.x-y: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

flavorText.gold-silver: It converts sun light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
flavorText.crystal: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this POKéMON's face become more vivid and lively.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SUNFLORA converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
flavorText.emerald: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
flavorText.platinum: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
flavorText.black-white: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.
flavorText.x-y: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon’s face become more vivid and lively.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

flavorText.gold-silver: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win dows in the area.
flavorText.crystal: It can see in all directions without moving its big eyes, helping it spot attackers and food right away.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: YANMA is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This POKéMON uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
flavorText.emerald: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
flavorText.platinum: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
flavorText.black-white: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By flapping its wings at high speed, it can fly freely through the air. Even sudden stops are no problem.
flavorText.x-y: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

flavorText.gold-silver: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
flavorText.crystal: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WOOPER usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
flavorText.emerald: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.
flavorText.platinum: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
flavorText.black-white: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

flavorText.gold-silver: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
flavorText.crystal: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: QUAGSIRE hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the POKéMON does not move, it does not get very hungry.
flavorText.emerald: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn’t move, it does not get very hungry.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
flavorText.platinum: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
flavorText.black-white: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
flavorText.x-y: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

flavorText.black-white: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
flavorText.gold-silver: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its ene my's actions.
flavorText.crystal: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said that this POKéMON developed its precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
flavorText.emerald: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.
flavorText.platinum: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather...and its foes’ thoughts.
flavorText.x-y: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can instantaneously sense its opponent’s movements by feeling air currents with its fine fur.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it originally had no powers at all, people say its precognitive faculties were awakened by its need to protect itself.
flavorText.sword-shield: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

flavorText.gold-silver: When agitated, this POKéMON pro tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
flavorText.crystal: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
flavorText.emerald: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon’s energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The light of the moon changed EEVEE’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
flavorText.platinum: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
flavorText.black-white: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it’s filled with a mysterious power.
flavorText.x-y: The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon’s waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
flavorText.sun-moon: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon is nocturnal. Even in total darkness, its large eyes can spot its prey clearly!
flavorText.sword-shield: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

flavorText.gold-silver: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
flavorText.crystal: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. MURKROW and MEOWTH loot one another's stashes.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MURKROW was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This POKéMON shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
flavorText.emerald: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.
flavorText.platinum: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
flavorText.black-white: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
flavorText.x-y: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another’s stashes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
flavorText.sun-moon: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, “Get home before the Murkrow fly.”
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It has a weakness for shiny things. It’s been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

flavorText.gold-silver: It has incredible intellect and in tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
flavorText.crystal: Every time it ya wns, SHELLDER injects more poi son into it. The poison makes it more intelligent.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SLOWKING undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this POKéMON apparently forgets everything it has learned if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
flavorText.emerald: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE’s head and unlocked an extraordinary power.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
flavorText.platinum: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
flavorText.black-white: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
flavorText.x-y: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
flavorText.sun-moon: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke’s latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.

flavorText.gold-silver: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
flavorText.crystal: It loves to watch people it's scar ed. It frightens them by screaming loudly or appear ing suddenly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The POKéMON apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
flavorText.emerald: A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
flavorText.x-y: It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into its red orbs. In daytime, it sleeps in darkness.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
flavorText.sun-moon: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

flavorText.gold-silver: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
flavorText.crystal: Because different types of UNOWN exist, it is said that they must have a variety of abilities.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
flavorText.platinum: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
flavorText.black-white: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.

flavorText.legends-arceus: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

flavorText.gold-silver: It hates light and shock. If attack ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter strike.
flavorText.crystal: In order to con ceal its black tail, it lives in a dark cave and only moves about at night.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If two or more WOBBUFFET meet, they will turn competitive and try to outdo each other’s endurance. However, they may try to see which one can endure the longest without food. TRAINERS need to beware of this habit.
flavorText.emerald: Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
flavorText.platinum: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
