flavorText.sword-shield: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
flavorText.crystal: When it is in danger, its tail uses some sort of mysterious powers to drive away the enemy.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GIRAFARIG’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this POKéMON from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.
flavorText.emerald: A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.
flavorText.platinum: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
flavorText.black-white: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
flavorText.x-y: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Girafarig’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.

flavorText.gold-silver: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
flavorText.crystal: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PINECO hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the POKéMON is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
flavorText.emerald: A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
flavorText.platinum: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.
flavorText.black-white: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
flavorText.x-y: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Motionless, it hangs from trees, waiting for its bug Pokémon prey to come to it. Its favorite in Alola is Cutiefly.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
flavorText.crystal: Usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the POKéMON is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
flavorText.emerald: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
flavorText.platinum: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.
flavorText.black-white: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
flavorText.x-y: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell’s inside cannot be seen.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When something approaches it, it fires off fragments of its steel shell in attack. This is not a conscious action but a conditioned reflex.

flavorText.gold-silver: When spotted, this POKéMON escapes backward by furi ously boring into the ground with its tail.
flavorText.crystal: It hides deep inside caves where no light ever reaches it and remains virtually motionless there.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
flavorText.emerald: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
flavorText.platinum: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
flavorText.black-white: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.
flavorText.x-y: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another’s tunnels happily.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon’s tiny wings have some scientists saying that Dunsparce used to fly through the sky in ancient times.

flavorText.gold-silver: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star tled victim to inject poison.
flavorText.crystal: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GLIGAR glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This POKéMON hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
flavorText.emerald: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.
flavorText.platinum: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
flavorText.black-white: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it’s stunned with surprise.
flavorText.x-y: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
flavorText.crystal: The many small metal particles that cover this POKéMON's body reflect bright light well.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: STEELIX lives even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig towards the earth’s core. There are records of this POKéMON reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
flavorText.emerald: STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig toward the earth’s core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
flavorText.platinum: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
flavorText.black-white: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.
flavorText.x-y: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth’s core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

flavorText.gold-silver: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
flavorText.crystal: In truth, it is a cowardly POKéMON. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON scurrying away in terror. However, this POKéMON seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
flavorText.emerald: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
flavorText.platinum: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
flavorText.black-white: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
flavorText.x-y: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
flavorText.sun-moon: Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

flavorText.gold-silver: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
flavorText.crystal: It can make most any POKéMON run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GRANBULL has a particularly well- developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
flavorText.emerald: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
flavorText.platinum: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
flavorText.black-white: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
flavorText.x-y: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

flavorText.sun-moon: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While it has powerful jaws, it doesn’t care for disputes, so it rarely has a chance to display their might.

flavorText.gold-silver: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
flavorText.crystal: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating itself. This POKéMON uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
flavorText.emerald: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
flavorText.platinum: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
flavorText.black-white: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

flavorText.legends-arceus: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

flavorText.gold-silver: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
flavorText.crystal: This POKéMON's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets a hold of into bits.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This POKéMON flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
flavorText.emerald: A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.
flavorText.platinum: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
flavorText.black-white: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
flavorText.sun-moon: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its body is like steel. Its tough, heavy pincers are more suited to smashing enemies than grabbing them.
flavorText.sword-shield: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor’s body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

flavorText.gold-silver: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
flavorText.crystal: The fluid secreted by its toes carves holes in rocks for nesting and can be mixed with BERRIES to make a drink.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
flavorText.emerald: A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
flavorText.platinum: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
flavorText.black-white: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
flavorText.x-y: The berries stored in its jar-like shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
flavorText.sword-shield: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

flavorText.gold-silver: This powerful POKéMON thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
flavorText.crystal: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HERACROSS charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This POKéMON even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
flavorText.emerald: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.
flavorText.platinum: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
flavorText.black-white: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.
flavorText.x-y: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe’s grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it’s always fighting with.
flavorText.sword-shield: Heracross loves sweet sap and will go looking through forests for it. The Pokémon uses its two antennae to pick up scents as it searches.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
flavorText.crystal: This cunning POKéMON hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This POKéMON seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
flavorText.emerald: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
flavorText.platinum: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
flavorText.black-white: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.
flavorText.x-y: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

flavorText.gold-silver: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
flavorText.crystal: It always licks honey. Its palm tastes sweet because of all the honey it has absorbed.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. TEDDIURSA concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
flavorText.emerald: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
flavorText.platinum: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
flavorText.black-white: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
flavorText.x-y: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

flavorText.gold-silver: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
flavorText.crystal: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: In the forests inhabited by URSARING, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This POKéMON walks through its forest gathering food every day.
flavorText.emerald: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an URSARING gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
flavorText.platinum: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.
flavorText.black-white: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
flavorText.x-y: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
flavorText.legends-arceus: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
flavorText.platinum: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
flavorText.gold-silver: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
flavorText.crystal: These group to gether in areas that are hotter than normal. If it cools off, its skin hardens.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Molten magma courses throughout SLUGMA’s circulatory system. If this POKéMON is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.
flavorText.emerald: It is a species of POKéMON that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
flavorText.black-white: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
flavorText.x-y: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

flavorText.gold-silver: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
flavorText.crystal: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAGCARGO’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile - just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This POKéMON returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.
flavorText.emerald: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO’s bodies into magma.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
flavorText.platinum: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
flavorText.black-white: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
flavorText.x-y: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.

flavorText.gold-silver: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
flavorText.crystal: It uses the tip of its nose to dig for food. Its nose is so tough that even frozen ground poses no problem.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This POKéMON occasionally roots out hot springs.
flavorText.emerald: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.
flavorText.platinum: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
flavorText.black-white: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Rooting the tip of its snout into the ground, it searches for food. Sometimes it even digs up a hot spring.
flavorText.x-y: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Swinub roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.
flavorText.sword-shield: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

flavorText.crystal: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
flavorText.gold-silver: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This POKéMON uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
flavorText.emerald: A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.
flavorText.platinum: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.
flavorText.black-white: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With its excellent sense of smell, it’s even able to find mushrooms that are buried under frozen ground.
flavorText.x-y: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

flavorText.gold-silver: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
flavorText.crystal: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CORSOLA’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this POKéMON grows it back in just one night.
flavorText.emerald: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
flavorText.platinum: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.
flavorText.black-white: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.
flavorText.x-y: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Corsola’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.
flavorText.sun-moon: Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The pink of Corsola that live in Alola is deep and vibrant, thanks to seas filled with nutrition.
flavorText.sword-shield: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

flavorText.gold-silver: It has superb ac curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
flavorText.crystal: To escape from an attacker, it may shoot water out of its mouth, then use that force to swim backward.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this POKéMON travels downstream from rivers.
flavorText.emerald: A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
flavorText.platinum: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
flavorText.black-white: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
flavorText.x-y: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Remoraid sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this Pokémon travels downstream from rivers.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!
flavorText.sword-shield: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

flavorText.gold-silver: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
flavorText.crystal: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This POKéMON tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, OCTILLERY spews ink to escape.
flavorText.emerald: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.
flavorText.platinum: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
flavorText.black-white: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
flavorText.x-y: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Octillery grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This Pokémon tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, Octillery spews ink to escape.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
flavorText.legends-arceus: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

flavorText.gold-silver: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
flavorText.crystal: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these POKéMON sharing its food.
flavorText.emerald: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
flavorText.platinum: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.
flavorText.black-white: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.
flavorText.x-y: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Delibird carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of the world’s highest mountain, thanks to one of these Pokémon sharing its food.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although it naturally prefers colder locales, Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the heat to a certain extent.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It shares its food with people who are stranded. Because Delibird is omnivorous, sometimes it gives those people bug Pokémon.
flavorText.sword-shield: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

flavorText.gold-silver: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
flavorText.crystal: It swims along freely, eating things that swim into its mouth. Its whole body is very coarse.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This POKéMON is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
flavorText.emerald: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.
flavorText.platinum: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores REMORAID that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
flavorText.black-white: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.
flavorText.x-y: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can fly over 300 feet out of the water from the surface of the ocean.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea’s waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Postcards and posters featuring Mantine leaping elegantly above the waves are popular souvenirs of Alola.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
flavorText.crystal: The feathers that it sheds are very sharp. It is said that people once used the feathers as swords.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SKARMORY is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This POKéMON flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
flavorText.platinum: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
flavorText.black-white: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.
flavorText.x-y: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.
flavorText.sword-shield: The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.

flavorText.gold-silver: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
flavorText.crystal: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HOUNDOUR hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON’s remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.
flavorText.emerald: HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON’s remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.
flavorText.platinum: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
flavorText.black-white: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

flavorText.crystal: During the desert ed morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.

flavorText.crystal: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from its tail is predeter mined for each SMEARGLE.

flavorText.crystal: To brush up on its fighting skills, it will challenge anyone. It has a very strong com petitive spirit.

flavorText.emerald: TYROGUE become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish a regular training schedule.

flavorText.crystal: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent's timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

flavorText.crystal: The sensitivity of its lips develops most quickly. It uses them to try to identify unknown objects.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SMOOCHUM actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn’t become dirty.
flavorText.emerald: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake’s surface to make sure its face hasn’t become dirty.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

flavorText.sword-shield: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn’t really seem to care.

flavorText.gold-silver: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
flavorText.crystal: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish- white when it is charging energy.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ELEKID stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this POKéMON begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
flavorText.emerald: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
flavorText.platinum: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.
flavorText.black-white: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes the area between its horns shine light blue.
flavorText.x-y: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Elekid stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it’s in a house, electrical outlets serve as its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When it hears the crash of thunder, Elekid’s mood improves. It can be useful to record that sound and play it when Elekid’s feeling down.
flavorText.sword-shield: When a storm approaches, this Pokémon gets restless. Once Elekid hears the sound of thunder, it gets full-on rowdy.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

flavorText.gold-silver: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
flavorText.crystal: It naturally spits an 1100-degree flame. It is said when many appear, it heralds a volcanic eruption.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAGBY’s state of health is determined by observing the fire it breathes. If the POKéMON is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
flavorText.emerald: If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don’t underestimate it.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.
flavorText.platinum: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.
flavorText.black-white: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees F. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.
flavorText.x-y: It’s small, but its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. Embers escape its mouth and nose when it breathes.

flavorText.sun-moon: Many of these Pokémon can be seen in areas with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When flames drip from its nose, that means it has a cold. Have it lie down for a nice rest in some magma.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is still small and timid. Whenever Magby gets excited or surprised, flames leak from its mouth and its nose.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
flavorText.crystal: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pull ing up and down on its udders.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
flavorText.emerald: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
flavorText.platinum: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It produces over five gallons of milk a day. The higher the quality of the pastures it lives in, the richer and tastier its milk becomes.
flavorText.sword-shield: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

flavorText.crystal: Biting into one of the delicious eggs that BLISSEY provides will make everyone around smile with joy.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BLISSEY senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this POKéMON will rush over to the sad person, however far they may be, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
flavorText.emerald: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.
flavorText.platinum: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

flavorText.black-white: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

flavorText.x-y: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Their eggs are such a delicacy that some say eating one will bring you happiness. These eggs fetch the highest prices on the market.
flavorText.sword-shield: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

flavorText.crystal: This brawny POKéMON courses around the earth, spouting flames hotter than a volcano's magma.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. This POKéMON is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
flavorText.emerald: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

flavorText.gold-silver: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
flavorText.crystal: This divine POKéMON blows around the world, always in search of a pure reservoir.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This POKéMON has the power to purify dirty water.
flavorText.emerald: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

flavorText.gold-silver: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
flavorText.crystal: Born deep under ground, this POKéMON becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this POKéMON must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see its parent’s face.
flavorText.emerald: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents’ faces.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Born underground, it eats its way through dirt to the surface, where its parents are. It doesn’t deal well with the bright light it finds there.
flavorText.sword-shield: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

flavorText.gold-silver: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
flavorText.crystal: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable - it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.
flavorText.emerald: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

flavorText.sword-shield: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

flavorText.crystal: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and moun tains crumble.

flavorText.crystal: It has an incred ible ability to calm raging sto rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.

flavorText.emerald: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
